map.📚 深度解析：磨料三项检测判定（粒度/硬度/寿命）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Abrasive (Particle Size / Hardness / Life)
map.磨料品质自检：按平均粒度、硬度、使用寿命三项判定: Abrasive quality self-check: judge by three items — mean particle size, hardness, service life
map.切削能力：硬度（莫氏）关系磨削效率: Cutting ability: Mohs hardness relates to grinding efficiency
map.逐项判定：平均粒度 10~50μm、硬度≥7 莫氏、使用寿命≥2000h；三项均: Item-by-item: mean particle size 10~50 μm, hardness ≥ 7 Mohs, service life ≥ 2000 h; all three satisfied = pass. Particle size sets surface roughness; hardness sets wear and cutting force.
map.粒度 30μm（区间✓）、硬度 8 莫氏（≥7 ✓）、寿命 2500h（≥200: Particle size 30 μm (range ✓), hardness 8 Mohs (≥7 ✓), life 2500 h (≥2000 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If hardness drops to 6 Mohs it fails, insufficient cutting force.
map.莫氏 7 约石英级，属较硬磨料（如刚玉更高）；低于 7 磨削效率低、易钝化，须按: Mohs 7 is about quartz level, a fairly hard abrasive (corundum is higher); below 7 has low grinding efficiency and dulls easily — choose hardness by the material being ground.
map.使用寿命 2000h 怎么定？: How is 2000 h service life determined?
map.为示例耐久下限，实际随负荷与冷却大幅变化；关键是: It is an example durability lower limit; actual varies greatly with load and cooling. The key is that wear rate stays within the allowable range — bench and field validation required.
map.在允许范围，须做台架与现场验证。: must stay within the allowable range; bench and field validation required.
map.粒度分析需使用激光粒度仪: Particle-size analysis requires a laser diffractor
map.莫氏硬度测试需用标准矿物刻划法: Mohs hardness testing requires the standard mineral-scratch method
